name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.

Royce's weight is higher than both the angler who landed the Bass and the angler at Grayreach.
The angler who landed the Crappie's weight is immediately below the angler at Stillwater.
